assay: whole-blood total RNA-seq (Nugen Ovation rRNA/globin-depleted), HiSeq 2500 PE100 (S2.5.p1)
cohort: 14 female ME/CFS patients and 11 matched sedentary female controls; CPET on day 1 and day 2; blood drawn before each CPET (day 1, day 2) and at home on day 3 and day 7 (S2.4.p1, S2.5.p1, S3.1.p1)
inclusion: 100 libraries; the day 3 and day 7 samples of one subject removed for <40% genes detected (S3.3.p1, SUP1 Fig A)
primary_estimand: Within-subject change in whole-blood gene expression after CPET (day 2, 3, 7 vs day 1) separately in ME/CFS and in controls (TAB3 lower block, S3.3.p2); secondary: ME/CFS-vs-control difference in the pre-to-post change (S3.3.p2)
planned_contrasts: Day 1 vs Day 2 within CFS (TAB3; paper: 0 DEGs)
Day 1 vs Day 2 within HC (TAB3; paper: 0 DEGs)
Day 1 vs Day 3 within CFS (TAB3; paper: 0 DEGs)
Day 1 vs Day 3 within HC (TAB3; paper: 0 DEGs)
Day 1 vs Day 7 within CFS (TAB3; paper: 0 DEGs)
Day 1 vs Day 7 within HC (TAB3; paper: 0 DEGs)
pre (day 1,2) vs post (day 3,7) change in ME/CFS compared to controls, overall and per time point (S3.3.p2; paper: 0 DEGs)
not_exercise_contrasts: ME/CFS vs controls per day and pooled, and low-VO2 / test-retest subsets vs regular (TAB3 upper block) are disease/phenotype comparisons, not exercise effects; the subset labels are not in GEO
paper_method: Partek Flow 5.0 gene-level FPKM (STAR/Cufflinks, hg38, RefSeq) with the Partek multimodel (GSA: normal, lognormal, lognormal-shrinkage, NB, Poisson chosen per gene by AICc) (S2.5.1.p1)

paper_threshold.interpretation: FDR < 0.1 (10%); Table 4 lists DEGs with FDR 0.06-0.10, which a literal 0.1% (0.001) rule would exclude

paper_results: No DEGs in any day-vs-day comparison in either group and none for the pre/post change in ME/CFS vs controls (S3.3.p2, TAB3, ABS.p1)
